relationships.subject: Oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: OXA increased Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS) production and lipoperoxidation, and augmented the content of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β and TNF-α) and expression of the astrocytic marker Gfap mRNA in the spinal cord.

relationships.subject: Antioxidants
relationships.evidence_quote: Oral treatment with antioxidants inhibited both mechanical and cold allodynia when concomitantly administrated with OXA (preventive protocol), as well as in animals with previously established CIPN (therapeutic protocol).

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Toll-like receptor 4 (Tlr4) and inflammasome enzyme caspase-1/11 knockout mice treated with OXA showed reduced levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines (but not oxidative stress) in the spinal cord, which were associated with resistance to OXA-induced mechanical allodynia.

key_findings: Oral antioxidants prevented and reversed oxaliplatin neuropathy without compromising antitumor efficacy
Tlr4 and caspase-1/11 knockout mice had reduced spinal cytokines and resisted OXA allodynia
